verdict.rationale: Fly.io is a cloud and edge-compute platform, and such platforms plausibly offer unified AI model gateways, so this axis applies. The evidence covers VMs, Sprites, hosting for MCP servers and managed Postgres, but never documents a single gateway endpoint for accessing many AI models. Hosting infrastructure on which a user could build their own gateway is a developer building block, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an ai-native builder, I can access hundreds of AI models through a single unified gateway endpoint
